note: 2026-10-23 DAILY BATCH, committed under the chairman's hand before any seat was convened. ONE QUESTION, ONE DOCKET, AND IT IS THE CURE ATTEMPT THAT YESTERDAY'S CLOSE-OUT STOPPED ONE NOTCH SHORT OF. WHAT THIS BATCH IS FOR. Objection 1021-C10 sustained a defect in an absence claim: the council's statement that the '(a) Original Proceeding / Published Decisions' document list on this docket names no 'Procedural Order No. 11' and no 'No. 12' rested on a COMPOSITE of eight page states, not on any single state. Yesterday's six rows moved No. 11's absence onto ONE state (sha256 80b026bb..., 105,769 bytes, run 39776432815) plus a derived ordering property -- the chairman's own adopted wording was that this is 'a better footing, not a cure', because yesterday's windows left THREE residual gaps in the list on that single state (objection 1022-C6, sustained, counted by the integrity officer and not by the chairman). THIS BATCH IS DESIGNED TO CLOSE ALL THREE ON ONE PAGE STATE, which would convert the absence claim from 'single state plus an unobserved ordering property' into 'single state, contiguous coverage' and cure 1021-C10 outright. HOW THE ROWS WERE CHOSEN, AND IT IS THE CORRECTION OF YESTERDAY'S DESIGN ERROR. Yesterday the chairman spaced three anchors across Gap A on the assumption that 400-character windows chain; rows 3 and 4 overlapped by 347 characters, which is most of a window spent twice, and Gap A stayed open. The lesson recorded was 'I estimated a span I could have bounded.' EVERY JOIN BELOW IS MEASURED AGAINST A COMMITTED WINDOW IN analytics/fetch-results/, not estimated, and where a join rests on a DIFFERENT page state than today's that is declared as an assumption rather than carried over as content. The anchor 'Counter-Memorial on Jurisdiction, Merits and Damages' is DELIBERATELY NOT RE-FIRED: it was the row whose 347-character overlap with 'Procedural Order No. 2' wasted yesterday's slot, and dropping it is what makes room for the interior anchors that actually close the gaps. THE NINE ROWS. R1 'Status of Proceeding' -- the certified companion control for every null-capable row in this batch, and the movement/field row. Proven: this find has returned TRUE on 4 separate states, at excerpt offset 150 each time, and it carries 'Latest Development:' in its window, which is where docket movement would first appear. R2 'Procedural Order No. 12' -- the chronology anchor, 1 fired / 1 TRUE (2026-10-21 records[5]). It re-establishes No. 12's list-absence on a CURRENT state; No. 12's absence presently rests on the 2026-10-21 state and nothing since, while No. 11's rests on yesterday's. R3 'December 16, 2025 Each party' -- FIRST FIRING of the un-hyphenated literal, and the batch's one genuinely null-capable row. THE SPAN-IN-SOURCE DEMONSTRATION THE CLOSE-OUT REQUIRED THIS NOTE TO CARRY, re-measured in session rather than restated: across all 723 committed result records the un-hyphenated literal occurs in exactly 1, at 2026-10-21-daily.json records[5] offset 322 (that row's find was 'Procedural Order No. 12'), and the hyphenated field form 'December 16, 2025 - Each party' occurs in exactly 6, every one of them a FIELD window (4x 'Status of Proceeding' at offset 150, 1x 'Latest Development', 1x 'Published Decisions'). THE NULL'S MEANING, PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE THE RUN so no successor reads it generically: a null on R3 while R1 and R2 hit means EITHER the chronology entry moved OR an HTML entity entered that locus -- NEVER 'the literal is absent'. ' ' is undecoded by excerpt_of and this page emits it in this very region (yesterday's row 6 returned '...organization of the hearing.  March 3, 2025...'). A null is therefore a two-valued result, not a finding. R4 'Confidentiality Order' -- Gap A chain step 1. Join to R1 measured at 140 characters on yesterday's state. R5 'RER-03 - Expert Opinion of Doug Uffen' -- GAP A's INTERIOR, the row yesterday's close-out named. Joins measured at 58 characters (from R4) and 96 (to R6). Proven: fired TRUE 2026-08-16 (sha e5a06176). Its window on that state ran '...Harold Paul Einarsson (Public Version) Claimants' Memorial RER-03 - Expert Opinion of Doug Uffen RER-02, Expert Report of Robert Hobbs RWS-03 - Witness Statement of Carl Makrides RER-04, Expert Re...', and R4's window yesterday ended '...LLP (Public Version) Witness Statement of Harold Paul Einar' -- so the join is on text R4 already holds. R6 'Procedural Order No. 2' -- Gap A's right close and Gap B's left anchor. Proven: TRUE yesterday. R7 'CER-04, Expert Report of Cameron Hutchison' -- GAP B IN ONE ROW, and this is the row that makes the batch worth firing, because Gap B is the locus where an entry inserted after No. 10 would sit. Proven: fired TRUE 2026-08-19 (sha 0bf789dc, records[5], offset 45), and on that state its single 400-character window ran from 'ocedural Order No. 9 Procedural Order No. 10 Rebuttal Memorial on Jurisdiction, Merits, and Damages CER-04 ... CER-05, Expert Report of Chip Gordon C. Gill CER-06, Expert Report of Paul Sharp (PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP) CER-07, Expert Report of Victor Ancira (Troik' -- i.e. it overlaps R6's right edge ('...No. 8 Procedural Order No. 9 Procedural Order ') on the left and R8's window on the right. DECLARED ASSUMPTION: that span is measured on the 2026-08-19 state, not on today's. If the list's ordering at that locus differs today, R7 will still return a window and the joins will simply be re-measured; what is NOT assumed is the content of today's gap. R8 'CWS-09' -- Gap B's right close. Proven: TRUE yesterday, window 'port of Paul Sharp (PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP) CER-07 ... CWS-09, Witness Statement of George Lau CWS-10 ... CWS-12, Witness Statement of Harold Paul Einarsson Canada's Rejoind', which bridges R7's right edge to R9's left reach. R9 'Expert Report of Mr. Robert Hobbes' -- GAP C, the list's own tail, 123 characters yesterday's six windows did not reach while 2026-10-21's five did. Proven: TRUE 2026-10-21 (records[3], offset 121); its window on that state covered 'Mr. Robert Hobbes Cumulative Index of supporting documentation Combined Hearing Transcripts Available on the ICSID Website' end to end with left margin to spare. WHAT A HIT ON ALL NINE WOULD AND WOULD NOT ESTABLISH. It would establish contiguous single-state coverage of the document list from the 'Status of Proceeding' field through 'Available on the ICSID Website', and therefore that the list on THAT state names no 'Procedural Order No. 11' and no 'No. 12'. It would NOT establish anything about any other state, about the dated-document section beyond R2/R3's windows, or about whether such an order exists and is merely unpublished -- the list is a publication list, and absence from it is absence from publication. COMPLIANCE, SCREENED BEFORE THIS NOTE WAS WRITTEN RATHER THAN AFTER (the discipline objection 1021-C18 imposed). All nine rows are on icsid.worldbank.org, which is on the relay's ALLOWED_HOSTS and is not under any standing prohibition. NO ROW touches www.italaw.com, investmentpolicy.unctad.org or any IISD path-family host -- those three remain under standing prohibition pending the operator's ruling (escalation 2, carried), and the chairman screened this batch against that list before writing it. web.archive.org is NOT requested: it is absent from ALLOWED_HOSTS, adding it is a scripts/ change outside this session's merge scope, and it is the operator's open escalation 1, not this session's to grant. Nine rows plus the mandatory control = 10 fetches, under MAX_URLS 12.
